title: Chris's band members and his use of mutes
summary: Jim Robinson played in the band, and Chris taught a former drummer, called Chita Howell in the transcript, to play trumpet. A clarinetist named Norwood quit. Chris started using mutes and plunger only after coming to the city, and crowds shouted 'preach'.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Chris Kelly, the blues trumpeter and his band
